scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @welody/shared && concurrently -k -n api,simulator -c blue,green "npm:dev:api:watch" "npm:dev:simulator:watch"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @welody/shared && npm run dev --workspace @welody/backend
scripts.dev:simulator: npm run build --workspace @welody/shared && npm run dev --workspace @welody/simulator
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @welody/shared && npm run build --workspace @welody/backend && npm run build --workspace @welody/simulator
